analyzed_vuln.description: ContextFormat2::closure() calls Coverage::intersects() on untrusted GSUB ContextFormat2 coverage data without ensuring the subtable has been sanitized first. Coverage::intersects() iterates via Coverage::Iter, which reads coverage/range records based on attacker-controlled lengths/offsets; for the PoC this causes iteration past the available table bytes and an 8-byte heap-buffer-overflow read in hb-ot-layout-common.hh:952.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In hb-subset-fuzzer, a crafted font is passed to hb_subset(); subset planning invokes _gsub_closure -> hb_ot_layout_lookups_substitute_closure -> SubstLookup::closure -> ContextFormat2::closure. The PoC provides malformed GSUB ContextFormat2 coverage/rule data (bad/truncated coverage structure) such that coverage iteration in Coverage::intersects() is out of bounds. Trigger requires reaching GSUB closure during subsetting (happens with this input) and malformed coverage offsets/counts that are not rejected before closure traversal.
